name: Every query anchored in a name
when: always, for a search that must return a specific person, work, institution or place rather than a topic
shape: at least one quoted proper noun per query (a person, a venue, an institution, a title); concept words only beside it
ingredients: the names the library holds for the task
yields: pages about the thing rather than pages about the topic
misses: a name shared by many (a namesake): pair it with a second anchor
origin: the Reporter's craft rule with 139 queries behind it; measured on the Riley harvest
